### Overview
Run GSEA on each histology for both paired (tumor vs adjacent normal) and unpaired (tumor vs healthy normal) RNA-seq differential expression results, using MSigDB Hallmark gene sets.

### Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(2025)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(msigdbr)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(glue)
library(rprojroot)
```

### Set directory paths

```{r dir-paths}
root_dir     <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-rna-expression")
results_dir  <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir     <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

histologies  <- c("DIPG or DMG", "EPN", "LGG", "MB")

hallmarks <- msigdbr("Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
```

## Loop Over Histologies and Contrasts

```{r run-gsea, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
for (hist in histologies) {
  message("Processing histology: ", hist)
  contrasts <- if (hist == "LGG")
    "healthyNormal" else c("healthyNormal", "paired")
  
  for (ctr in contrasts) {
    message(" - Contrast: ", ctr)
    fname <- if (ctr == "paired")
      glue("DESeq2_{hist}_paired_full.csv") else glue("DESeq2_{hist}_vs_{ctr}.csv")
    path <- file.path(results_dir, fname)
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
      message("   ✗ Missing ", fname, "; skipping")
      next
    }
    
    # Load DE results and build LFC vector
    de_df <- read_csv(path, col_types = cols())
    lfc <- de_df %>% 
      pull(log2FoldChange, name = gene_symbol) %>%
      sort(decreasing = TRUE)
    
    # Run GSEA
    gsea_res <- GSEA(
      geneList     = lfc,
      TERM2GENE    = hallmarks,
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      pAdjustMethod= "BH",
      minGSSize    = 25,
      maxGSSize    = 500
    )
    
    # Convert results to tibble
    res_tbl <- as_tibble(gsea_res@result)
    if (nrow(res_tbl) == 0) {
      message("   ✗ No enriched pathways for ", hist, " / ", ctr, "; skipping output.")
      next
    }
    
    # Save results table
    out_table <- glue("{hist}_{ctr}_GSEA_results.tsv")
    res_tbl %>%
      arrange(desc(NES)) %>%
      write_tsv(file.path(results_dir, out_table))
    message("   ✓ Saved results: ", out_table)
    
    # Plot top 5 pathways by absolute NES
    top5 <- res_tbl %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(NES), n = 5) %>% pull(ID)
    for (gs in top5) {
      p <- gseaplot(gsea_res, geneSetID = gs, title = gs, color.line = "#0066FF")
      ggsave(
        filename = file.path(plot_dir, glue("{hist}_{ctr}_{gs}_GSEA.pdf")),
        plot     = p,
        width    = 8,
        height   = 6
      )
      message("     ✓ Plotted: ", gs)
    }
  }
}
```
